author: LuckyReggie

title: Cordoba, Setinil and Ronda trip.
text: Antonio our guide was an absolute gem, he was so friendly from the start and informative all throughout the trip. He has excellent knowledge of the history of Spain and of the places we visited today, Cordoba, Setinil and Ronda. I cannot recommend him, our driver Juan and the trip itself highly enough. It is a 13hour day but well worth it. Thank you Antonio for making it so interesting.

title: Great 3 city excursion.

title: Amazing 3 Citi tour with Antonio.
text: Amazing tour. Didn’t feel like 13 hours long. Antonio the guide is very knowledgeable and sincere and knows history well to make it enjoyable! Very professional and informative. Toured the mosque in cordoba with added tickets. So worth it. Senetil was beautiful. Ronda in evening with sunset just mystical! Great tour. Do it!

title: Beautiful and fascinating places
text: Fantastic trip with a good itinerary with enough time for the tour and to explore. Antonio was a great guide. Very knowledgeable and clear. The sites we went to were all beautiful and interesting.

author: OnAir52527620119

title: Great tour with Antonio
text: The 3 ciudades tour was wonderful. Time was a little short in Cordoba, but visiting 3 cities in 1 day is almost impossible otherwise ha ha. Special mention to Ronda, that we had the pleasure to discover at sunset. We had an amazing time with Antonio, our very informative and sympathetic guide, he was eager to share his knowledge and recommendations.
author: Travel05339171750

title: Thank you Enrique for being the best tour guide.
text: Enrique, our the best tour guide! He is very professional tour guide. His explanation in English was easy to understand and clear. He took care everyone very well.  Our trip from Seville to Ronda was smooth and fun.
author: angelakG7324VF

title: Maraming Salamat Enrique
text: Cordoba, white village and Ronda is a must try if you are going southern part of Spain. Thanks to Enrique who helped us to appreciate the places we visited. He is an energetic, knowledgeable and you can really feel his passion for what he’s doing. He also help me and my friend to secure a last minute booking for Cordoba tickets for that we are very grateful. Gracias! Adios compañero! Maraming Salamat! Vamos!
